resolve_company.name: resolve_company
resolve_company.description: Find an Indian listed company by name, ticker or partial match. Returns candidates with their MarketPing slug — call this FIRST unless you already hold a slug, because every other company tool takes one. Factual data only — MarketPing publishes no buy/sell recommendations, no price targets and no IPO grey-market premium.

query.description: Company name, NSE/BSE symbol, or part of one

company_snapshot.name: company_snapshot
company_snapshot.description: Latest fundamentals and valuation for one company: price, market cap, P/E, P/B, TTM revenue and profit, growth, ROCE/ROE and debt ratios. Use for 'how is X doing', 'what does X trade at', or as the numeric backdrop before reading filings. Factual data only — MarketPing publishes no buy/sell recommendations, no price targets and no IPO grey-market premium.

company.description: Company slug (preferred), NSE symbol, or UUID

search_filings.name: search_filings
search_filings.description: Full-text search across every page MarketPing holds — annual reports, earnings-call transcripts, investor presentations. Returns {doc_id, page, snippet} hits to follow up with read_pages. SNIPPETS ARE KEYWORD WINDOWS, NOT FACTS: never state a figure from a snippet, open the page and take it from there. Factual data only — MarketPing publishes no buy/sell recommendations, no price targets and no IPO grey-market premium.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words

company.description: Optional — restrict the search to one company

list_documents.name: list_documents
list_documents.description: The documents MarketPing holds for a company — annual reports, earnings-call transcripts, investor presentations, results — newest first, each with a doc_id. A capped list is marked as truncated: never read one as the whole holding. Factual data only — MarketPing publishes no buy/sell recommendations, no price targets and no IPO grey-market premium.

company.description: Company slug, NSE symbol, or UUID

doc_contents.name: doc_contents
doc_contents.description: A document's table of contents: section titles, one-line summaries and page ranges. Read this BEFORE read_pages so you open the right four pages instead of guessing — annual reports run to 300+ pages. Factual data only — MarketPing publishes no buy/sell recommendations, no price targets and no IPO grey-market premium.

doc_id.description: Document id from list_documents or search_filings

read_pages.name: read_pages
read_pages.description: The actual text of a page range (max 12 pages). This is the ONLY source you may quote a document from — cite as {doc_id, page, verbatim quote}, and the quote must really appear on that page. Factual data only — MarketPing publishes no buy/sell recommendations, no price targets and no IPO grey-market premium.

page_to.description: Last page; at most 12 pages per call
